title: Check placement dates and times across all app surfaces
body: Owner direction: dates and times need to match throughout all surfaces of the app. After the remaining current-visit versus full-residency discrepancy was identified, the owner requested the fix, merge and live release, and asked to update project memory so this is checked moving forward. Implementation rule: AGENTS.md, Cross-surface event dates and placement windows. Check Sky cards, article headers and Key dates, Calendar and shared You/Friends timing in the selected time zone. Primary current direct placement dates and countdowns use the current continuous visit; a multi-visit full residency is labeled separately. Preserve final-exit body variables, retrograde station windows and archive scope. This records technical task direction, not approval of reader wording.
